generation.scope: All Klein homogeneous windows with nonzero common diagonal bracket, including every sparse coefficient pattern, are decided. The 293 Boolean supports form 19 cases under axes and rotations. Of the 18 sparse cases two are empty, thirteen have exact rational function field Hilbert obstructions valid also at all specializations, and three are regular at every allowed parameter, with dimensions zero, one and two. Smith character quotients, finite unmarked isomorphism, and periods dividing two complete this chart.
